fields.Name: Skip ICF - Member Lifetime Value by Join Year
fields.Description: Average confirmed order revenue per member by join-year cohort, drill to category split and then transactions. Ported from "Member Lifetime Value by Join Year".

InputDefinition.userMessage: Calculate the average lifetime value (total confirmed order revenue) for members grouped by the year they joined, and show it in a chart. When I click a year, show me a pie chart of that cohort's revenue by product category. Then let me click a slice to see the actual members and order lines. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a chart of average lifetime value by join year
Lifetime value uses confirmed sales orders billed to the member (Order Headers BillToPersonID)
Older cohorts have higher LTV (about $3,000-3,700 for 2013-2019 joiners, falling to a few hundred dollars for 2026 joiners)
Clicking a year shows a pie chart of that cohort's revenue by product category
Clicking a slice shows the members and order lines behind it
Rows can open the member or order record
